headline: Database updates consolidate variant, population and endogenous retrovirus references into unified resources
label: Curated Genomic Database Resources
summary: Three NAR database papers show curated, integrated reference resources spanning national omics archives, Indian population variation and human endogenous retroviruses.
synthesis: The items share a focus on consolidating dispersed genomic data into curated, queryable reference resources rather than on metadata harmonization of public archives. The CNCB-NGDC 2027 update describes expanded database resources and web services, including thirteen new resources covering genome variation and health and disease. GI-DB addresses the underrepresentation of the ethnolinguistically and biogeographically diverse Indian population in global genomic resources by providing a dedicated variant database. ERV Navigator unifies human endogenous retrovirus annotations, nomenclatures and genomic loci in one phylogenetically informed reference. What is new is the emphasis on population-specific coverage and on reconciling nomenclature and annotation across sources. The provided summaries do not report benchmarks or quantitative comparisons, so the evidence is descriptive of resource scope.
